scope: Runtime skill discovery, instruction/reference reading and task-local management. No user-global Codex skills, Hermes host, shell preprocessing, auto-installation or secret collection.

ports.adaptation: Extracted complete frontmatter/platform algorithms and environment-declaration normalization. Replaced Hermes ruamel host helper with application PyYAML safe loader; malformed YAML is explicit error instead of line fallback. Preserve newline before closing fence for block scalars. Host discovery/config/plugin/credential behavior excluded.

Application-owned direct ToolSpec/ToolExecutor adaptation of list/view/manage behaviors. Explicit read-only root IDs, exact IDs for ambiguity, task-local skill management with hashed stale-write protection and archives. Existing effect journal/resources control all tools. Rewritten filesystem/root/permission host seams; not a wholesale copied Hermes skill manager. Backend-visible task directory mapping and full authorized-library package import are application integration additions. Original package bytes/modes retained with per-file source hashes; copying does not execute or install.

reviewed_dependency_edges: skills_tool -> skill_utils -> Hermes config/profile/project trust and disabled lists: replaced by operator-explicit roots and grant filtering
skills_tool -> skills_tool_setup -> env capture, env_passthrough, credential_files, pm.ensure: declaration normalization retained; capture/passthrough/auto-install not executed
skills_tool -> skills_tool_plugin, registry, skill_view_dedup, skill_usage: plugin host and global registry removed; direct tools and no view dedup hiding content

skill_manager_tool -> skill_manager_guards, skill_manager_batch, skill_usage/ledger, atomic_write_text: app scoped mutation/backups; per-call single operation; no whole-host skill management or batch claim
agent/skill_utils -> hermes_yaml (ruamel.yaml): replaced with pinned PyYAML safe load; YAML parsing difference explicitly recorded

contract.pagination: Character offsets and next_offset for complete UTF-8 or base64 content
contract.effect_semantics: IO failure after mutation starts becomes unknown, blocks future writes on same resources; no auto replay
contract.workspace_display_root: Optional str or Callable[[context_id], str]; sandbox caller passes /workspace. Task skill_dir is backend-visible; workspace_relative_path remains executable relative to task cwd. Library view tells caller to import before sandbox execution.
contract.import_permissions: Requires source skills:root:<id>, destination skills:task:<context_id>, and every existing mutation_resources grant. Source must be a configured read-only library.

import_bounds.completeness: All regular files and directories, including hidden package data; no silently skipped files. Symlink/junction/special file or limit violation refuses before destination mutation.

contract.import_recovery: Preflight complete bounded source package, exclusive target directory, keep source provenance .history/imports/<id>.json, copy/verify files, publish SKILL.md last via exclusive hard-link creation. IO failure after mutation begins returns unknown with retained partial target/audit paths. No automatic cleanup or replay; shared effect resources block a fresh call_id/destination name until reconciliation.

limitations: Read-only configured roots must not be symlink/junction paths. No flat legacy *.md skill catalog or plugin namespace registry.
Symlink containment checks are not an OS filesystem sandbox against hostile concurrent local writers.
No batch-mutation atomicity, skill store cross-process multi-writer lock or operator archive restore tool claimed; one runtime owns skill mutations and backups are retained.
Declared deps and credential files are reported as setup_needed until separate setup; metadata guidance cannot grant privileges or invoke tools.
Runtime Skills are not a promise that every third-party script/dependency works on current machine.

validation.result: 30 passed (Windows local integration including actual subprocess execution of imported Python script with package-relative asset; no bwrap, model or QQ claim)

hash_audit.note: Final frozen src/tests/tools byte inventory. Shared-file hashes cover application-owned integration changes too; source attribution applies only to the specifically described algorithms/behaviors, not every line of a shared target. Original validation observations are retained.
